note: Cause, evidence and catch set by M1b-1 (#332). The entry-cap guard of a fill publication is the `capture.suffix.past_entry_cap` check in `install`. Also agreed at the obligation record warm-takeover-retains-s-across-host-loss and REFUSE-BEFORE-ACK of crates/kestrike/src/storage/recovery/suffix.rs. The history passes at the head with the guard's refusal as its witness; the control plants the acknowledged fill from the test tree, by running the tenure under a layout one entry wider and loading the successor under the history's layout through a probe.

evidence.steps: The trigger needs a tenure whose records layout has an entry cap below its pool's slot count, which publishes fills up to the cap, publishes a capture pass, opens its suffix and then publishes one more fill, and a successor that attaches the same media warm. Before this unit no world ran those steps: `rg -ln 'entries:' crates/kestrike/src/net/world_tests` lists only `histories/warm_loads.rs`, whose one layout held the 41 entries of a data unit over a pool of eight slots, so no history's membership reached its cap, and the live and cluster profiles start no capture pass and open no suffix (`rg -ln 'start_capture|open_suffix' crates/kestrike/src/net/world_tests crates/kestrike/src/sim` lists only `histories/warm_loads.rs`). The history wl3-fill-past-cap-refused runs those steps under a cap of 3.
evidence.sweep: One sweep at 628788031 of cluster-swarm, cluster-pressure and upload, archive build de9f5a81b9f2842e24b746246d280b07aaf9610a887ea2b188a1d915a4cfc2be, campaign bsw-ct1-2100-profiles, 28 workers, 121 s, counts {}: cluster-swarm 13891 runs (0..13890), 10755 pass, 3136 uncredited, 0 suspects; cluster-pressure 34765 runs (0..34764), 34320 pass, 445 uncredited, 0 suspects; upload 392404 runs (0..392403), 392404 pass, 0 uncredited, 0 suspects; controls 4509 runs, 3372 caught, 0 missed; 79 replays, 0 suspects, none of class replay differs. The trigger's code is unchanged since that commit: `git log 628788031..c4c5813fe` lists no commit that touches crates/kestrike/src/storage/publication.rs or crates/kestrike/src/storage/recovery/suffix.rs. Every run of the three profiles reaches the steps above at most in part: no profile of the set records under a layout or opens a suffix.
